data: Generated public synthetic text only; no user records, signatures, credentials or diagnostic data.
scope: Shared CSV/XLSX parser with real temporary Node SQLite shared-string index and awaited consumer callbacks. Desktop measurement, not Android/iOS device, WebView bridge, native transaction or complete production UI acceptance.
memoryNote: V8 old-space flag is not a process RSS limit. Peaks include fixture generation and parsing; RSS also includes native SQLite, buffers and runtime.
fixtureNote: XLSX uses stored ZIP entries so actual source exceeds 512 MiB. Its 16384 public body cells each contain 32768 UTF-8 bytes but fewer than Excel's 32767 UTF-16-character cell limit. CSV has 96 independent 1 MiB body fields.
completeSourceProof: Every pass must consume the complete byte count and match independent writer SHA-256; ZIP payload CRC and structure validated by parser. Every body matched an independently regenerated SHA-256, including quotes, newlines, Chinese and emoji.
compatibilityFollowup: After this scale measurement, BOM decoding was extended to UTF-16 LE/BE and empty chart-sheet compatibility was added. The scale hot path and six-pass source validation were unchanged; dedicated compatibility tests were rerun.
